Personality: Rikaharduz, a prominent figure of the Semnones, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Rikaharduz owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Semnones. Historical Record: King of the Semnones, keepers of the sacred grove of the Suebi (a name of the Semnonian kings). Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
